description: Fetch a web page and return its main content as clean Markdown (no navigation, ads or footers). Use this to read articles, docs, blog posts or any page the user mentions. Handles JavaScript-rendered pages. 1 credit.

max_chars.description: Truncate the Markdown to this many characters. Default 50,000.

url.description: Full URL of the web page, including https://

name: url_to_markdown
title: Read a web page as Markdown
